skill.name: localaipicks
skill.description: Find open-weight AI models that run on the user's own hardware with Local AI Picks, with weight file sizes, memory needs, sources and test status. Use when the user asks which local LLM, coding, speech, image, video, music, translation or OCR model fits their Mac, GPU or RAM, or wants to compare open-weight models before downloading. No key needed.
skill.summary: Find and compare open-weight models for your device and available memory.

content.user_title: Find Local AI Models for Your Hardware
content.value_statement: Choosing an open-weight model can be difficult when hardware memory is limited. Local AI Picks helps compare model weights, memory needs, and sources for your device.
actual_capabilities: Identify the relevant memory type for Apple Silicon, GPU, or CPU devices.
Find models by task, device type, and available memory when the MCP server is connected.
Compare listed weight options, file sizes, licenses, and context lengths.
Report memory requirements, source links, and the catalog date when available.
Direct users to relevant task or model pages when MCP tools are unavailable.
limitations: MCP-based searches require the Local AI Picks server to be connected.
Memory requirements for non-text tasks may be vendor-sourced or unknown.
The catalog provides no ratings or speed estimates.
A listed memory fit does not guarantee successful execution on every system.

output_examples.input: Find a text model for my 16 GB Mac.
output_examples.output: A result can list a model, a fitting weight option, its file size, estimated memory requirement, source link, and catalog date.
A comparison can show each model's available weight options, file sizes, licenses, and context lengths.

best_practices: Provide the task, device type, and relevant available memory.
Check the source and catalog date before downloading model weights.
Verify the model license and leave memory available for system overhead.
anti_patterns: Do not assume disk file size equals runtime memory use.
Do not treat unknown memory requirements as confirmed compatibility.
Do not assume the catalog provides speed estimates or model ratings.

faq.question: What models can I search for?
faq.answer: The skill covers open-weight models across tasks such as text, coding, speech, image, video, music, translation, and OCR.

faq.question: What hardware details should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide your device type and relevant memory: unified memory, GPU VRAM, or system RAM.

faq.question: Is the MCP server required?
faq.answer: The MCP server is required for tool-based searches and comparisons. Without it, the skill can link to website pages.

faq.question: Are memory requirements always known?
faq.answer: No. Text model memory may be estimated, while other task requirements may come from vendors or be unknown.

faq.question: Does the catalog estimate speed?
faq.answer: No. The instructions state that the site provides no speed estimates or ratings.

faq.question: Does a memory match guarantee a model will run?
faq.answer: No. Runtime configuration and other system requirements can affect whether a model runs successfully.
